create_inference_client: create an InferenceClient instance with an HF_TOKEN environment variable for API authentication
create_chat_completion: create a chat completion request with a vision-language model and multimodal messages
stream_chat_response: stream chat completion responses chunk by chunk from a VLM inference endpoint
send_multimodal_message: send a multimodal message containing text and image_url content to a vision-language model
iterate_stream_chunks: iterate over streamed response chunks and print delta content incrementally
